incidents-bot: PagerDuty alert: [HIGH] Metering emitter variance > 12% in eu1. Possible delayed emits causing overage flags. https://redwood.internal/alerts/6601234567

Maya: seeing a backlog and delayed flushes from emitter-eu1, started ~14m ago. customers getting overage emails :grimacing:

Zack: oncall here, taking lead. Maya can you share the tail of emitter logs? `kubectl logs emitter-eu1 --since=2h | tail -n 200`

Maya: pasted excerpt:
```
WARN  emitter   backlog flush delayed=320s
ERROR kafka-producer write timeout attempt=1/3
INFO  emitter   flush window=300s tokens=+124k origin=shadow
```

Irina: billing pipeline shows late windows and a small set of accounts (CUS-9xxx) with duplicated token counts. Overages were auto-flagged 11m ago.

Samir: copying runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-delay — mitigation steps listed there.

Linda: product-ops: any customer-facing impact confirmed? We have 3 accounts flagged and one nonce invoice generated.

Zack: mitigation plan: (1) pause overage alerting for eu1, (2) restart backfill consumer, (3) enable emitter debug and rate-limit retries, (4) run dedupe backfill. I'll execute 1 now.

Zack: POST to featureflags service: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags -d '{"alerts.metering.pause.eu1":true}'` -> 200 OK :white_check_mark:

Maya: restarting consumer-batch-eu1 now (rolling restart)

ops-bot: consumer-batch-eu1 restart triggered by Maya (run_id=r-9302).

Maya: restart completed, reprocessing backlog. Estimated catch-up ~18m based on current throughput.

Irina: initial reconciliation shows a ~+3% duplicated token delta on affected accounts — looks like a transient retry loop created duplicate emitter messages with same external_id missing.

Samir: safe patch for emitter idempotency is ready on branch `hotfix/emitter-dedupe`. Will deploy canary to eu1 in 5m.

Zack: product-ops, please send a holding message to impacted CSMs and pause any automated billing emails for those accounts.

Linda: posted holding message to #customer-notify and pinged CSMs. link: https://slack.com/archives/CUSTOMER-ALERTS/p-6601234567

Maya: metrics: backlog depth decreasing, consumer lag trending to zero, no new overage flags after toggle.

Irina: follow-ups: (A) add strong idempotency keys to emitter messages, (B) add alerting on emitter write latency > 200ms, (C) add automated canary to alert toggles. Owners: Maya/Irina/Samir.

Zack: handoff: I'm handing off oncall to Samir at 6601238200. Notes added to incident INC-2026 with links to logs and the reconciliation spreadsheet.

incidents-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied, backlog processing resumed, overage alerts paused. Follow-up ticket INC-2026 created for root-cause and billing reconciliation.
